sound.title: Sound
ftue.pointerGoal: Goal: flip your card face up and land it on an enemy's face-down card.
tut.s1.title: SLAM CLOSE TO YOUR CARD!
tut.s1.body: Slam the table next to your card, not on it. The closer you slam, the harder it jumps.
tut.s1.hint.touch: Drag to aim, release to slam.
tut.s1.hint.mouse: Move the mouse to aim, click to slam.
tut.s2.title: FACE UP ON FACE DOWN WINS!
tut.s2.body: Your card flips face up and lands on top of an enemy's face-down card: you take it.
tut.s3.title: DON'T KNOCK A CARD OFF!
tut.s3.body: Knock any card off the table and you're out. Go easy near the edge.
tut.s4.title: TIME OUT TWICE AND YOU'RE OUT!
tut.s4.body: Each turn has {two} seconds ({more} with 3–4 players). Run out of time 2 turns in a row and you're out of the round. Win {n} rounds to win the match!
tut.s5.title: FLAT OR TILTED?
tut.s5.body: Flat slam{q}: the card flies high. Tilted slam{e}: it skims low. Slamming close? Go tilted to flip it face up for sure.
tut.s5.hint.touch: Switch with the 2 buttons at the bottom, from your 2nd match.
tut.s6.title: WATCH THE WIND!
tut.s6.body: The top corner shows WIND 0–4 with an arrow. Wind pushes cards while they fly, so a flat slam (high) drifts more.
tut.s7.title: PASSED A TURN?
tut.s7.body: Slam empty table or run out of time and you pass. Next turn you must slam inside the small pink ring by your card.
tut.s1.c1: Far away: the card won't budge
tut.s1.c2: Close: the card flips face up!
tut.s2.c1: Face up on face down = YOURS!
tut.s3.c1: A hard slam by the edge...
tut.s5.c1: Flat: flies high, often lands face down
tut.s5.c2: Tilted: skims low, flips face up
tut.s7.c1: Passed last turn (empty slam / time out)...
tut.s7.c2: ...this turn, slam inside the small pink ring
tut.findAgain: Forgot the rules? Tap ? to see the {n} steps again.
tut.remind.types.title: New: 2 ways to slam!
tut.remind.types.body: Flat flies high. Tilted skims low, flips easier up close.
tut.remind.wind.title: Wind's up!
tut.remind.wind.body: Top corner: WIND and its arrow. It pushes cards in the air; flat slams drift more.
tut.remind.forced.title: Slam inside the pink ring!
tut.remind.forced.body: You passed, so this turn you must slam inside the small pink ring by your card.
